info.title: Asset OS — Backend API Contracts
info.summary: B2 verified OIDC-backed Asset Registry, lifecycle, acquisition, ownership and disposition
info.description: B2 implements guarded PostgreSQL lifecycle/acquisition/ownership/disposition commands and read-only history. All writes require verified tenant member, strong If-Match ETag and Idempotency-Key. Assets remain user-entered facts; no Finance OS ledger posting or legal ownership verification is implied. Production issuer and API host require operator configuration.
